author: BlueberryHopes
body:
Hey, I was Christer192 on Minecraft, but changed my username to BlueberryHopes.

I was banned due Excessive Infractions on 3. July 2015 by MidnightBeth.

I've sent an appeal request before, 8 months ago. https://avicus.net/forums/410fe3af2
I have now been waiting long to be un-banned, so I hope I'll get another chance. 

Regards,
BlueberryHopes

replies.author: Jahaj
replies.body:
Hey BlueberryHopes,

Sorry it has been a little while but MidnightBeth isn't a mod anymore and a Senior will have to deal with this appeal. It shouldn't be too much longer, but in the meantime please be patient and don't spam your appeal with comments, it doesn't help.

Regards,
Jahaj

replies.body:
Hello,

Due to the amount of infractions you currently have, I've decided to deny your appeal. You didn't learn after getting 24 infractions, which clearly shows you continued to break rules until you were permanently punished.

Best Regards, 
-Zeusy
